comment: Book of Stray Minutes, page 2 of 12: kitchens. Linden always has the kettle on, so the page warms her to the finder. The page id p-kitchen is kept from the starter set.

reward.text: The Kitchen Minutes page is full, and it smells of toast and warm tea. Tucked in the spine is a small wooden spoon, worn crooked by a thousand cups.

do.name: wooden spoon
do.seed: a small wooden spoon worn smooth and slightly crooked by a thousand cups stirred; it smells, faintly and forever, of bergamot

collectibles.name: the kettle minute
collectibles.text: a kettle watched so hard it held its breath, then all at once began to sing

collectibles.name: the toast minute
collectibles.text: toast held to the fire on a long fork, golden on one side and a little too brave on the other

collectibles.name: the last-biscuit minute
collectibles.text: two people politely not taking the last biscuit, for quite a long time

collectibles.name: the steam minute
collectibles.text: a cup of tea too hot to drink and too good to leave

collectibles.name: the cupboard minute
collectibles.text: an open cupboard, a puzzled face, and no memory at all of what it had been opened for

collectibles.name: the dough minute
collectibles.text: a grandmother's floury hands showing smaller hands how to knead

collectibles.name: the recipe minute
collectibles.text: a recipe card found at the back of a drawer, in a handwriting still loved

collectibles.name: the washing-up minute
collectibles.text: the washing-up done side by side in easy silence, each plate passed from hand to hand

collectibles.name: the mixing-bowl minute
collectibles.text: the cake spoon licked clean, and then, when nobody was looking, the bowl

collectibles.name: the jam-lid minute
collectibles.text: a jam-jar lid that would not turn, would not turn, and then all at once did

collectibles.name: the new-bread minute
collectibles.text: the smell of warm bread climbing all the way to the top of the stairs

collectibles.name: the apple-peel minute
collectibles.text: an apple peeled in one long unbroken curl, with nobody daring to breathe until the end

collectibles.name: the cocoa minute
collectibles.text: a skin forming on a mug of cocoa while someone finished a very long story

collectibles.name: the fork-side minute
collectibles.text: a small child laying the table with great seriousness and every fork on the wrong side
